text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D8","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 20"}],"comment":"The ⌀20 diameter (D8) on a stop pin is the functional mating feature that locates or stops against another part, yet it carries no fit or tolerance callout. Without a defined fit the pin may not seat correctly in its hole, causing misalignment or failure to stop. The designer should add an appropriate fit designation (e.g., h7, g6) or explicit tolerances to D8.","recommended_correction":"Add a fit or tolerance callout to dimension D8 suitable for the pin's locating function."}]}
